biro_sl.tH1: Delamo v stavbah, ki se ne smejo ustaviti
biro_sl.tP1: BIRO VOLK je arhitekturni biro iz Ljubljane, ustanovljen leta 2007. Projektiramo nova dvigala, univerzalno dostopnost in prenove šol, dijaških domov, domov za starejše in bolnišnic — pogosto v stavbah, ki med gradnjo delujejo naprej.
biro_sl.tP2: Vodimo projekt od idejne zasnove do dovoljenja za uporabo: projektiranje, pridobivanje dovoljenj, ocene investicij in nadzor. Druge stroke vključujemo iz stalne mreže inženirjev, s katerimi delamo že vrsto let.
biro_sl.tRole1: univ. dipl. inž. arh., pooblaščeni arhitekt ZAPS
biro_sl.tTeam: Pri vsakem projektu sestavimo ekipo glede na nalogo: gradbene konstrukcije, strojne in električne instalacije, požarna varnost, geodezija in drugi elaborati. Naročnik ima eno kontaktno osebo in eno pogodbo.
biro_sl.tAbroadP: Tu smo projekte že izvedli. Odprti smo za nove v Evropi, Rusiji, na Bližnjem vzhodu, v Afriki in Aziji, tudi na Kitajskem. V sodelovanju z lokalnimi arhitekti in projektivnimi biroji prevzamemo zasnovo, vodenje projektiranja in strokovno svetovanje. Delamo v slovenščini in angleščini.
biro_sl.tAbroadShort: Odprti smo za projekte v Evropi, Rusiji, na Bližnjem vzhodu, v Afriki in Aziji.

biro_en.tH1: We work in buildings that cannot stop
biro_en.tP1: BIRO VOLK is an architecture studio in Ljubljana, founded in 2007. We design new lifts, universal access and renovations of schools, student residences, care homes and hospitals — often in buildings that stay in use while we build.
biro_en.tP2: We lead projects from concept design to occupancy permit: design, permitting, investment appraisals and supervision. Other disciplines are covered by a long-standing network of engineers we work with.
biro_en.tRole1: architect, licensed member of the Slovenian Chamber of Architecture (ZAPS)
biro_en.tTeam: For each project we assemble the team the task requires: structures, mechanical and electrical services, fire safety, surveying and other studies. The client has one contact and one contract.
biro_en.tAbroadP: We have completed projects here. We are open to new ones in Europe, Russia, the Middle East, Africa and Asia, including China. Working with local architects and design institutes, we take on concept design, design management and expert advice. We work in Slovenian and English.
biro_en.tAbroadShort: We are open to projects in Europe, Russia, the Middle East, Africa and Asia.
